landing.title: BILKENT SECRET GIFTS
landing.subtitle: Match with a random Bilkent student and exchange a surprise gift on campus as we enter the new year
landing.step1Desc: Sign up with your Bilkent student email address (@ug.bilkent.edu.tr, @cs.bilkent.edu.tr, etc.). Click the verification link sent to your email to activate your account.
landing.step2Desc: Complete your profile: specify your department, study level, and interests. This information will help your matched person choose an appropriate gift for you.
landing.step3Desc: Our system will match you with a Bilkent student using an algorithm. After matching, you'll see your match's interests, but the full name will remain hidden (only initials are shown).
landing.step4Desc: Propose 3 different days and times to meet your match at the designated on-campus location. You'll agree on a common time and meet up.
landing.step5Desc: Meet at the determined date and location to deliver your gift. Budget: 200-500 TL. This should be a surprise!

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.desc: Only you will know who you're giving a gift to. Your match won't know who you are either - it's a surprise!

timing.title: Timing
timing.desc: After matching, meet at the determined date and location to exchange gifts. Don't miss your appointment!

giftSelection.title: Gift Selection
giftSelection.desc: Choose a thoughtful gift based on interests. Budget: 200-500 TL. Be creative!

fun.title: Fun
fun.desc: This is a New Year celebration! Have fun, make new friendships, and enjoy the New Year spirit!
